notes.title: Major Update 2021!
notes.content: Lots of graphical and technical updates on all the levels! Adjusted difficulty levels and improvements!

notes.title: FREE DEMO now available!
notes.content:
You can now download a FREE demo version of the game!

DEMO includes:
- 3 FREE levels!
- Tutorial level
- Introductions and game menu

FREE LEVELS are:
- Tutorial Level
- Episode 1 Level 1 (Mail for Hippos)
- Episode 2 Level 2 (Night Shift)
- Episode 3 Level 3 (Cave Expedition)

FULL VERSION will get you all the Episodes and Levels, including upcoming Chinese New Year special episode (15 new levels, January 2017)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27155950/3467a3969b51478d4f414679153b1e3347ad5736.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.03 and Tutorial video now out!
notes.content:
UPDATE V1.03
Elephant Express VR version update 1.03 brings improvements to graphics and some bug fixes. You can update the game normally via Steam client.

TUTORIAL VIDEO
Tutorial video on "How to Get Started with Controllers" has been added to the community hub VIDEOS section.

LAUNCH DISCOUNT 10% STILL VALID FEW MORE DAYS!
